description: Makes the site's pass for automated tools (testing tools, uptime checks): anything of the site that asks for sign-in lets a request carrying it in, without an account. A new pass replaces the old one, which stops working at once. Returns the pass and how tools send it; treat it like a password and give it only to the person. Only owners and admins.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.
